question:
Let \(x\) be a positive number. A sequence \(\{x_n\}\) of real numbers is defined as follows:
\[
x_1=\frac12\left(x+\frac5x\right),\qquad x_2=\frac12\left(x_1+\frac5{x_1}\right),\qquad\ldots,
\]
and in general,
\[
x_{n+1}=\frac12\left(x_n+\frac5{x_n}\right)\quad\text{for all }n\ge1.
\]
(a) Show that, for all \(n\ge1\),
\[
\frac{x_n-\sqrt5}{x_n+\sqrt5}=\left(\frac{x-\sqrt5}{x+\sqrt5}\right)^{2^n}.
\]
(b) Hence find \(\lim_{n\to\infty}x_n\).

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
